newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan companies set up transport firm in Vietnam.
newsitem.headline: Japan companies set up transport firm in Vietnam.

text.p: Japan Logistic Systems Corp said on Friday that it, Nippon Yusen, Itochu Corp and an Itochu unit have set up a joint venture in Vietnam and received the Vietnamese government's approval to operate a shipping business.
The joint venture will offer door-to-door transport services between Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City.
The firm will operate cargo ships between the ports of Haiphong, located near Hanoi, and Ho Chi Minh City, Japan Logistic said in a statement.
The joint venture was set up in June and expects sales of $10 million in the first year.
The venture, which is capitalised at $3 million, is 40 percent held by the four Japanese companies, while the rest is owned by three local Vietnamese companies.
